academic.title: Agentic-MRP
academic.description: Research focus on Predictive AI Manufacturing System evolving into autonomous agent-based MRP with predictive analytics. Features discrete event simulation for manufacturing optimization, supply chain intelligence with automated procurement decisions, and real-time production planning with inventory optimization.
academic.impact: 🎯 Impact: Developing autonomous manufacturing decisions with predictive analytics for Master's thesis

academic.title: LLM-Chat-RAG
academic.description: Advanced AI chat system with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector databases. Features OpenAI GPT integration, OCR capabilities for PDF processing, microservices architecture with explainable AI responses and source citation.
academic.impact: 🎯 Impact: Intelligent document processing with source citation and explainable AI

academic.title: Himalayan-DataVis
academic.description: Interactive data science platform for mountaineering expedition analysis (2020-2024). Features Grammar of Graphics visualization with Altair/Vega-Lite, real-time data exploration with statistical analysis, and multi-dimensional analysis with geographic insights.
academic.impact: 🎯 Impact: Ready for deployment on Streamlit Cloud with statistical analysis capabilities

academic.title: MisVids
academic.description: Enterprise video streaming platform with microservices separation. Features AES-256 encryption for video file security, JWT authentication, HTTP Range streaming, YouTube integration with embedded video support, and production-ready deployment.
academic.impact: 🎯 Impact: Enterprise Java application with comprehensive security and streaming capabilities

creative.title: MuseoVirtualAR
creative.description: Augmented Reality museum experience with image marker tracking and multi-marker support. Features multilingual system (Spanish/English) with synchronized audio, 3D cultural artifacts (Buddha, Christ the Redeemer, Chichen Itza), and cross-platform deployment with gesture recognition.
creative.impact: 🎯 Impact: Immersive cultural heritage experience for educational institutions

creative.title: CalabozoVR
creative.description: Immersive VR escape room with gaze-based interactions and dual locomotion modes. Optimized for Google Cardboard with performance optimization for sustained 60 FPS.
creative.impact: 🎯 Impact: Mobile VR optimization with dual locomotion modes

creative.title: Audio-Splitter
creative.description: Professional audio processing suite with modular architecture for music production and podcast workflows. Features multi-format support, advanced metadata management, precision audio splitting with CLI + Interactive UI. Currently expanding to web platform.
creative.impact: 🎯 Impact: Production-ready for music production workflows, expanding to browser-based platform

enterprise.title: ERP2 Full-Stack
enterprise.description: Modern enterprise system currently in production on LAMP hosting, transitioning to cloud-native deployment on AWS. Full-stack solution with Laravel REST API backend and Angular SPA frontend. Planned AWS infrastructure includes ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, and ALB with Docker-first development and complete DevOps pipeline using infrastructure as code.
enterprise.impact: 🎯 Impact: Production enterprise system serving multi-location retail operations, migrating to scalable cloud infrastructure

enterprise.title: CFDI Full-Stack
enterprise.description: Mexican government tax compliance system (CFDI 3.3 & 4.0 support) with full-stack architecture. AngularJS SPA frontend with Bootstrap UI and PHP backend API. Features OAuth2 authentication, PAC integration for fiscal certification, cryptographic operations, real-time tax authority integration with batch processing, and multi-emisor support.
enterprise.impact: 🎯 Impact: Government compliance system serving thousands of businesses with fiscal certification and tax authority integration

enterprise.title: uniCenta oPOS Fork
enterprise.description: Open source maintainer of enterprise POS system used globally. Features multi-terminal support with hardware integration, international localization (13+ languages), and community leadership with legacy system modernization.
enterprise.impact: 🎯 Impact: Global community contribution benefiting enterprise POS deployments

enterprise.title: Node POS Integration
enterprise.description: Full-stack restaurant management system serving as the central integration hub for the complete enterprise ecosystem: ERP2 Full-Stack, CFDI Full-Stack, uniCenta oPOS Fork, and WebESCPOSPrint Bridge. Features complete POS operations, multi-location support, inventory control, automatic CFDI 4.0 electronic invoicing, financial management with cash flow control, and seamless thermal printing integration.
enterprise.impact: 🎯 Impact: Central integration hub orchestrating 4 enterprise systems (ERP2, CFDI, uniCenta POS, WebESCPOSPrint) for complete restaurant management ecosystem

enterprise.title: WebESCPOSPrint Bridge
enterprise.description: Java desktop application enabling web-to-printer communication for ESC/POS thermal printers. HTTP server bridge allowing web applications (ERP2/CFDI systems) to print receipts and tickets directly to local thermal printers through Base64-encoded commands and CORS-enabled API.
enterprise.impact: 🎯 Impact: Critical system integration enabling seamless printing from web-based POS and billing systems
